# Functional Test Cases of the Prototype {#sec-appendix-functional-tests}

| Post | Text | Humanitarian Category | Entities |
|:-----|:------------------------------|:----------------|:------------------------------|
| P1 | "Need po namin ng rescue dito sa Brgy. Tumana, hanggang bubong na ang tubig" | Requests or urgent needs | REQUEST = "Need po namin ng rescue". LOCATION = "Brgy. Tumana" |
| P2 | "Signal No. 3 na sa Quezon dahil kay Bagyong Henry, stay indoors everyone" | Caution and advice | NUMBER = "Signal No. 3". LOCATION = "Quezon". DISASTER_TYPE = "Bagyong Henry" |
| P3 | "Nagpadala ang Philippine Red Cross ng relief goods sa evacuation center" | Rescue, volunteering, or donation effort | ORGANIZATION = "Philippine Red Cross". RESOURCE = "relief goods" |
| P4 | "Praying for everyone affected by the baha, ingat kayong lahat" | Sympathy and support | None |
| P5 | "Almost 200 families na ang nasa covered court ng Marikina" | Displaced people and evacuations | DISPLACED = "Almost 200 families". LOCATION = "Marikina" |
| P6 | "Baha na sa kalsada namin, please send help sa Barangay Malanday" | Requests or urgent needs | REQUEST = "please send help". LOCATION = "Barangay Malanday" |

: Constructed Test Posts and Their Fixed Labels {#tbl-functional-test-posts tbl-colwidths="[6,40,20,34]"}

| Test Case ID | Use Case | Functional Requirement | Pre-requisites | Test Data | Step Details | Expected Result | Actual Result | Status |
|:----|:--------|:------------|:--------|:--------|:------------|:------------|:-------|:----|
| FT-01 | None (post stream) | The system shall label each post of the stream with the final model, find the coordinates of its locations in the place list, and store the post with its labels | The database is empty, the post stream holds the texts of P1 to P6, and the place list holds Marikina, Quezon, Barangay Tumana in Marikina, and two barangays named Malanday | Texts of P1 to P6 | The tester starts the post stream | The database holds six posts, each with one humanitarian category and its entities. P1, P2, and P5 have coordinates, and P3, P4, and P6 have none |  |  |
| FT-02 | None (post stream) | The system shall label the posts of the stream in the same way as the final model in the evaluation | The database is empty, and the post stream holds 20 posts of the test set | 20 posts of the test set and the labels that the final model gave them in the evaluation | The tester starts the post stream | Each of the 20 posts has the same humanitarian category and the same entities as in the evaluation |  |  |
| FT-03 | View posts on a map | The system shall show each post that has a matched location as a point on the map | The server is running, and the database holds P1 to P6 with their fixed labels and coordinates | P1 to P6 | The responder opens the prototype in a web browser | The map shows a point for P1 at Barangay Tumana, for P2 at Quezon, and for P5 at Marikina, and no point for P3 and P4 |  |  |
| FT-04 | View posts on a map | The system shall not place a post whose location matches more than one place | Same as FT-03 | P6 | The responder looks for P6 on the map and in the table | P6 has no point on the map, and its row in the table is marked as having an unmatched location |  |  |
| FT-05 | View posts in a table | The system shall show each post in a table with its time, its text, its humanitarian category, and its entities | Same as FT-03 | P1 to P6 | The responder opens the table | The table has six rows, each with the text, the humanitarian category, and the entities listed in @tbl-functional-test-posts |  |  |
| FT-06 | View the details of a post | The system shall show the full text of a selected post with each entity highlighted by entity type | Same as FT-03 | P2 | The responder selects the row of P2 in the table | "Signal No. 3" is highlighted as NUMBER, "Quezon" as LOCATION, and "Bagyong Henry" as DISASTER_TYPE |  |  |
| FT-07 | View the details of a post | The system shall show the full text of a selected post with each entity highlighted by entity type | Same as FT-03 | P4 | The responder selects the row of P4 in the table | P4 shows its text with nothing highlighted |  |  |
| FT-08 | View the details of a post | The system shall show the details of a post when its point on the map is selected | Same as FT-03 | P5 | The responder selects the point at Marikina | The details of P5 are shown, with "Almost 200 families" highlighted as DISPLACED and "Marikina" as LOCATION |  |  |
| FT-09 | Filter posts by category | The system shall show only the posts assigned the categories that the responder selects | Same as FT-03 | P1 to P6 | The responder selects Requests or urgent needs in the category filter | The table shows only P1 and P6, and the map shows only the point of P1 |  |  |
| FT-10 | Filter posts by category | The system shall show only the posts assigned the categories that the responder selects | Same as FT-03 | P1 to P6 | The responder selects Requests or urgent needs and Caution and advice in the category filter | The table shows only P1, P2, and P6 |  |  |
| FT-11 | Filter posts by entity type | The system shall show only the posts that contain at least one entity of the entity types that the responder selects | Same as FT-03 | P1 to P6 | The responder selects LOCATION in the entity type filter | The table shows only P1, P2, P5, and P6 |  |  |
| FT-12 | Filter posts by category and Filter posts by entity type | The system shall show only the posts that match both the selected categories and the selected entity types | Same as FT-03 | P1 to P6 | The responder selects Requests or urgent needs and Caution and advice in the category filter, and REQUEST in the entity type filter | The table shows only P1 and P6 |  |  |
| FT-13 | Filter posts by category and Filter posts by entity type | The system shall show only the posts that match both the selected categories and the selected entity types | Same as FT-03 | P1 to P6 | The responder selects Sympathy and support in the category filter and LOCATION in the entity type filter | The table shows no posts |  |  |
| FT-14 | Filter posts by category and Filter posts by entity type | The system shall show every post again when the responder removes all selected categories and entity types | The filters of FT-12 are selected | P1 to P6 | The responder clears the filters | The table shows all six posts |  |  |
| FT-15 | Filter posts by location | The system shall show only the posts placed in the selected province, city, or municipality, including its barangays | Same as FT-03 | P1 to P6 | The responder selects Marikina in the location filter | The table and the map show only P1 and P5 |  |  |
| FT-16 | Search posts by keyword | The system shall show only the posts whose text contains the word or phrase that the responder types | Same as FT-03 | P1 to P6 | The responder types "rescue" in the search box | The table shows only P1 |  |  |
| FT-17 | Search posts by keyword | The system shall show only the posts whose text contains the word or phrase that the responder types | Same as FT-03 | P1 to P6 | The responder types "baha" in the search box | The table shows only P4 and P6 |  |  |
| FT-18 | View a summary of posts | The system shall show the number of posts in each humanitarian category and in each province, city, or municipality | Same as FT-03 | P1 to P6 | The responder opens the summary | The summary shows two posts for Requests or urgent needs and one post for each of the other four categories of P1 to P6.
